purpose: A column header cell: names the column, can hold a select-all Checkbox and, when sortable, shows the sort direction and sorts on click or key.

notFor.case: Not for standalone use: one per column inside a TableHeader.

Default.visual: Fill Surface/muted; label in Content/secondary (Content/primary when sorted), Type/label.

Hover.meaning: The pointer is over a sortable column; only sortable columns hover.
Hover.visual: Fill moves to Surface/muted-hover on use-hover.

Sort=none.meaning: Not the sorted column. The person triggers onSort; the app decides the order.

Sort=ascending.visual: Up arrow in Content/primary (Size/icon-sm); label in Content/primary; aria-sort=ascending.

Sort=descending.visual: Down arrow in Content/primary (Size/icon-sm); label in Content/primary; aria-sort=descending.

a11y.keyboard: With onSort the header is a button: Tab reaches it and Enter or Space calls onSort. Without onSort it is not focusable.
a11y.reducedMotion: Fill and ink changes run on use-hover, which keeps its duration under reduced motion: a colour change, not travel (lib/motion.ts KEEP_UNDER_REDUCED).
notes: aria-sort is set on the sorted column and omitted for none.
Code draws Border/focus on a focus-visible sortable header; the Figma set has no Focused variant.

openQuestions: Contrast: the label (Content/secondary on Surface/muted) measures 4.22:1 in Light, below AA for text (table-contract.md). Keep it as Figma binds it, or change a role?
Focus: code draws Border/focus on a focused sortable header but the Figma set has no Focused state. Should Figma get one?
Sort cycle: does a third press go back to none, or only toggle ascending / descending? The contract leaves it to onSort.
